title: Google Docs
prompt: Design a collaborative document editor like Google Docs where many users edit the same document simultaneously and see each other's changes and cursors in real time.
functionalReqs: Changes appear for others within ~100 ms
Version history and offline edits that merge later
nonFunctionalReqs: All replicas converge to the same document

scale.qps: ~1M concurrent documents, up to 100 editors per doc

deepDives: Routing editors of one doc to one session server
